name: create_server_sessions
query: create table if not exists public.server_sessions (session_id text primary key, owner_key text not null, device_label text not null, user_agent text, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), last_seen_at timestamptz not null default now(), expires_at timestamptz not null, revoked_at timestamptz); create index if not exists server_sessions_owner_idx on public.server_sessions(owner_key); alter table public.server_sessions enable row level security;
